record: California Office of Historic Preservation, National Register nomination
facts: Primary west elevation with three round-arched entry bays, three chamfered upper balcony openings, low hipped clay roof, two-faced roof lettering. Five south arches and three inset upper quatrefoils. Whole building occupies its parcel.
The individual theatre is the two-storey Williams building at 128 Palm Canyon Drive, APN 513144010.

record: Plaza Theatre Foundation approved restoration description
facts: Original exterior retained, with new glass entrance doors set into the existing arches.
